The path ratio recursion R_{m+1}=1/(1+z R_m) proves nonvanishing, |R_m|<=1 and Re(zR_m)>=0 throughout the closed right half-plane. With u=z/(1+z)^a, v=z/(1+z)^b, |u|,|v|<=1/2 and Re(u),Re(v)>−1/3; the remaining uvR term has modulus <=1/4, yielding >1/12 real part. The d=1 expression gives >1/3. Unbounded stability follows from the analytic inequalities, not the numerical roots.
